PARAMS = {
    "Wp": (40.0, 10.0, 120.0),     # PMOS mirror width (um), deep subthreshold -> low VSG
    "Lp": (8.0, 2.0, 16.0),        # PMOS mirror L (um), high VA for line reg / PSRR
    "Wn": (4.0, 1.0, 16.0),        # NMOS level-shift pair W
    "Ln": (4.0, 1.0, 10.0),        # NMOS level-shift pair L
    "R1": (215e3, 100e3, 500e3),   # PTAT resistor
    "Rc": (2.3e6, 1.0e6, 5.0e6),   # CTAT (Banba) resistors
    "RL": (1.76e6, 1.0e6, 3.0e6),  # output load resistor -> sets vref
    "Cpg": (1e-12, 0.1e-12, 5e-12) # pg-to-vdd cap: helps pg track VDD (PSRR)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N = 8
    Wp, Lp, Wn, Ln = p["Wp"], p["Lp"], p["Wn"], p["Ln"]
    R1, Rc, RL = p["R1"], p["Rc"], p["RL"]

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # --- Branch A: PMOS source -> NMOS diode -> Q1 (x1) || Rc
    n.M("M3", "ng", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M1", "ng", "ng", "e1", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=1)
    n.R("Rc1", "e1", "vss", Rc)
    # --- Branch B: PMOS diode -> NMOS follower -> R1 -> Q2 (xN), Rc at top of R1
    n.M("M4", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M2", "pg", "ng", "e2p", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)
    n.R("R1", "e2p", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=N)
    n.R("Rc2", "e2p", "vss", Rc)
    # --- Output branch: mirrored (PTAT + CTAT) current into RL
    n.M("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.R("RL", "vref", "vss", RL)
    # --- Start-up: nfet diode pg->ng conducts only when core is off (pg high, ng low)
    n.M("MST", "pg", "pg", "ng", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 4.0)
    n.C("Cpg", "pg", "vdd", p["Cpg"])

    # ---------------- first-order predictions ----------------
    T0 = 300.15
    def ut(T): return 1.380649e-23 * T / 1.602176634e-19
    def veb(I, T, m=1):
        # Veb(10uA,300K)=0.76 V for one 3.4um unit; Vg0=1.17, eta~3
        v0 = 0.76 + ut(T0) * math.log(max(I, 1e-12) / (10e-6 * m))
        return 1.17 - (1.17 - v0) * T / T0 - 2.0 * ut(T) * math.log(T / T0)

    def solve(T):
        Iq = ut(T) * math.log(N) / R1          # PNP current (PTAT)
        Ve = veb(Iq, T, 1)
        Ib = Iq + Ve / Rc                      # branch current
        return Ib, RL * Ib, Ve

    Ib27, v27, ve27 = solve(T0)
    vs = [solve(t + 273.15)[1] for t in (-40, -10, 27, 60, 90, 125)]
    tc = (max(vs) - min(vs)) / (v27 * 165.0) * 1e6

    # line regulation: dominated by PMOS output conductance (subthreshold VA ~ k*L)
    VA = 10.0 * Lp
    line_reg = v27 * (1.0 / VA) * 0.7          # partial core self-compensation
    psrr = -20 * math.log10(max(line_reg, 1e-6))

    Itot = 3 * Ib27
    power = 1.8 * Itot

    # headroom check for M2 (pg - e2p) at 27 C, VSG estimate in subthreshold
    vsg = 0.78
    try:
        lt = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, 0.78, 0.8)
        if lt["Id"] > 0:
            vsg = 0.78 + 1.4 * ut(T0) * math.log(Ib27 / lt["Id"])
    except Exception:
        pass
    vds_m2 = (1.8 - vsg) - ve27

    return n, {"vref": v27, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": line_reg, "power": power,
               "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1,
               "I_branch": Ib27, "vds_M2": vds_m2}
